name: view_duel_catch_up_says_no_old_moments
description: A networked duel's catch-up says none of the duel's moments again (Game._on_duel and _say_rival keep quiet while the client catches up or reconnects, as a teammate's seat notice does: Game._catching_up). Through tests/net/loopback_main.gd against the fake sequencer in mode undertow: the partner corks in window 2 and I cork; in wave 2 the partner uncorks its pack on my road and I uncork mine, each said once. Then my link is cut and comes back: the rejoin loads the checkpoint the sequencer kept after the horn and runs the turns since again, both uncorkings among them, yet no rival's moment is said a second time (nor their sounds played), while what the events change of my corks still holds: my bottle open, no salt left waiting.

steps.msg: live, the rival's cork and uncorking are each said once

steps.wait_until: not scene.client.reconnecting and not scene.client.catching_up and scene.client.resyncs.size() >= 1

steps.msg: the rejoin's checkpoint is from before both uncorkings: their turns ran again

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.my_bottles().is_empty() and Game._corks.is_empty() and Game._corks_waiting.is_empty()
steps.msg: what the events change of my corks still ran
